description: This file defines the main React component 'MindmapClient' for the 'career-navigator' web application's front-end. It manages state related to the mindmap visualization, fetches graph data and node details from APIs, handles view state persistence, and renders the UI including filters, the mindmap canvas, and role detail panels.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a number within specified min and max bounds.

methods.name: defaultFilters
methods.description: Provides default filter settings for the mindmap.

methods.name: defaultState
methods.description: Provides default view state for the mindmap, including zoom, pan, and filter settings.

methods.name: toSafeState
methods.description: Sanitizes and converts an arbitrary object into a valid 'MindmapViewState', applying defaults where needed.

methods.name: safeErrorMessage
methods.description: Converts an unknown error into a user-friendly string message.

methods.name: getUserKey
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a stable anonymous user key for tracking session without authentication.

methods.name: computeEmptyStateReason
methods.description: Determines the reason why the mindmap might be empty or not display, based on current status and data.

methods.name: DebugRow
methods.description: React component rendering a debug information row with label and value.

methods.name: MindmapClient
methods.description: Main React component managing the mindmap view, data fetching, state persistence, and rendering the UI.
